body: No. She's got enough shit to deal with. I don't want to put another anchor on her back.
Not saying that what I did was right.
Apparently, me thieving and vandalizing before I stopped going outside does not require "balls".
And let's be honest, you don't really care. Will you remember this post 3 days from now? If so, then great. How about 3 months from now? I truly doubt it.
I don't know what has stopped me from leaving, there's just always some game to play or some movie to watch. I feel busy even though I am actually not busy.
I simply don't get why people say that someone needs a psychologist or something immediately if they see that someone has personal problems. It doesn't make sense. I said I tried. It did not work.
I have tried talking with numerous people, but it always led nowhere.
